# Suwenzo

> Suwenzo is clinic software for Sri Lanka that connects the doctor's desk, patient records and dispensary in one system, with WhatsApp reminders so patients return on time.

Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, Suwenzo is built for private outpatient medical practices—including solo general practitioners, private clinics with an attached dispensary, consulting-only rooms, and multi-doctor group clinics.

## Key Pages & Documentation

- [Home](https://www.suwenzo.com/): Overview of the connected consultation desk, dispensary queue, and WhatsApp follow-up workflow.
- [Fact Sheet](https://www.suwenzo.com/facts): Verified specifications, hardware requirements, 48-hour setup timeline, and commercial terms.
- [FAQ](https://www.suwenzo.com/faq): 20 verified answers on hardware, setup, offline behavior, patient consent, and clinic support.
- [About](https://www.suwenzo.com/about): Background on the Colombo-based team and why the software was designed for Sri Lankan outpatient practices.
- [Contact](https://www.suwenzo.com/contact): Direct WhatsApp and email contact channels for demonstrations and clinic support.

### Features
- [Patient Records](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/patient-records): Tablet-based visit history, past diagnoses, and pinned allergy safety flags.
- [Digital Prescriptions](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/digital-prescriptions): Prescriptions appear on the dispensary screen within seconds with thermal envelope label printing.
- [Dispensary Stock & Expiry](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/stock-and-expiry): Automated pill deductions upon dispensing with proactive batch expiry alerts.
- [WhatsApp Follow-Up Reminders](https://www.suwenzo.com/features/whatsapp-reminders): Automated review reminders sent with explicit patient consent.

### Practice Types
- [Solo Doctors](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/solo-doctors): Lightweight single-tablet consultation setup for independent practitioners.
- [Clinics with Dispensary](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/clinics-with-dispensary): Synchronized workflow between doctor's desk and dispensary counter.
- [Consulting-Only Practices](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/consulting-only-practices): Clean printed prescription slips for practices without an internal dispensary.
- [Multi-Doctor Practices](https://www.suwenzo.com/for/multi-doctor-practices): Shared patient history across doctor shifts and unified dispensary queues.

### Articles & Guides
- [Paper vs Digital Clinic Records](https://www.suwenzo.com/blog/paper-vs-digital-clinic-records-sri-lanka): Why outpatient clinics are replacing paper filing cabinets.
- [Prescription Flow to Dispensary](https://www.suwenzo.com/blog/prescription-flow-doctor-to-dispensary): Eliminating handwriting bottlenecks between doctor and dispenser.
- [Clinic Software Guide](https://www.suwenzo.com/blog/what-to-look-for-in-clinic-software-sri-lanka): Evaluation checklist for private practices in Sri Lanka.

## Fast Facts
- Hardware: Standard tablet/PC for doctor; PC/tablet + thermal label printer for dispensary.
- Network: Active internet connection required (no offline mode; mobile hotspot supported).
- Setup: Most clinics are ready within 48 hours of the demo.
- Commercial Terms: Pricing is shared during the demo. The first 10 founding clinics in Colombo get 3 months free.
- Reminders: Dispatched via WhatsApp with explicit patient consent.
- Online Consultations: Not available today (in-person outpatient clinics only).
